- **Claims data can't be split by territory.** The approved abandonment source, the claims table (`RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ`), is anonymised and has no prescriber on it. So there's no way to tie an abandoned claim to a territory or a rep.
- **The patient-level data isn't allowed for this.** The only table that could make that link is `RAW_3P.PATHPT_LVL`. The policy check refused it for your role and this purpose. Policy POL-DUA-01, under the data licence DUA-3P-07, bars patient-level data from being used to evaluate or coach reps or territories. A territory abandonment view for coaching would break that, so I didn't run it.

Below are two approved alternatives for the last 13 weeks (weeks ending 3 Jul – 25 Sep 2026).

**1. Lacrivia abandonment, national and by payer channel** (for access context, not for judging territories)

| Channel | Rejected claims | Abandoned after rejection | Abandonment rate | Rejection rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **All** | **2,367** | **601** | **25.4%** | **18.5%** |
| Commercial | 1,216 | 318 | 26.2% | 17.7% |
| Medicare Part D | 542 | 128 | 23.6% | 19.9% |
| Managed Medicaid | 309 | 76 | 24.6% | 23.6% |
| Health Exchange | 224 | 56 | 25.0% | 27.6% |
| Medicaid (state-run, not managed plans) | 76 | 23 | 30.3% | 14.8% |

About 1 in 4 rejected Lacrivia claims ends in abandonment, fairly evenly across channels. That makes it an access and payer issue for Market Access, not something reps in particular territories are causing.

**2. For coaching: Lacrivia total and new prescriptions by territory (last 13 weeks vs the 13 weeks before)**

Most territories are growing. These are the ones worth a coaching conversation:

- **New prescriptions falling:** T022 (District 02) −11.5% (77 vs 87), T063 (District 06) −9.9% (100 vs 111), T032 (District 03) −4.0%, T033 (District 03) −0.4%. T033 is still the biggest territory with 844 total prescriptions, so this is flat new-patient growth.
- **Total prescriptions falling:** T051 −3.9%, T054 −2.7% (both District 05), T044 (District 04) −2.2%.
- **Strongest new-prescription growth:** T023 +30.7%, T021 +30.6%, T041 +30.2%, T024 +27.9%. T042 is +167%, but that's only 16 vs 6.

I have the full 24-territory table and can send it.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Abandonment:** the approved metric "abandonment after rejection" (Market Access) = rejected claims the patient abandoned ÷ all rejected claims. Rejection rate = rejected ÷ (paid + rejected); reversed claims are left out.
- **Tables:** the claims table and the payer and channel lookups for part 1. Weekly prescriptions (`RXT_WKLY`) → prescriber → territory for part 2, using the approved link from prescriber to territory.
- **Policies:** the policy check (POL-DUA-01, DUA-3P-07) refused the patient-level data. POL-PHI-02 says patient IDs must never appear in results.

**Assumptions**
- Lacrivia means both packs (0.1% in 5 mL and 10 mL).
- The 13 weeks run through the week ending 25 Sep 2026, the latest full week. Claims were matched to the same window (27 Jun – 25 Sep).
- Territory is the prescriber's assigned territory.
- Claims from 26–30 Sep fall in an incomplete week and were left out.

If you need abandonment tracked at territory level, you'd need a data-use agreement that allows it. Market Access would have to ask for that. This decision is logged as trace a096d4cf.

  SUM(CASE WHEN c.ADJ_STAT='R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REJECTED,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.ADJ_STAT='R' AND c.ABNDN_FLG='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REJ_ABANDONED,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.ADJ_STAT='R' AND c.ABNDN_FLG='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.ADJ_STAT='R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),4) AS ABANDON_AFTER_REJ,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.ADJ_STAT='R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.ADJ_STAT IN ('P','R') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),4) AS REJECTION_RATE
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c
LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE s ON c.PLAN_ID = s.PLAN_ID
LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.REF.CHNL ch ON s.CHNL_CD = ch.CHNL_CD
WHERE c.PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110')
  AND c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ch.CHNL_NM, s.CHNL_CD), ())
ORDER BY REJECTED DESC

SELECT t.DISTRICT_ID, t.TERR_ID, t.TERR_NM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT >= '2026-07-03' THEN r.TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS TRX_L13,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT <  '2026-07-03' THEN r.TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS TRX_P13,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT >= '2026-07-03' THEN r.TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT < '2026-07-03' THEN r.TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END),0) - 1, 4) AS TRX_CHG,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT >= '2026-07-03' THEN r.NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NRX_L13,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT <  '2026-07-03' THEN r.NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NRX_P13,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT >= '2026-07-03' THEN r.NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.WK_END_DT < '2026-07-03' THEN r.NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END),0) - 1, 4) AS NRX_CHG
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON r.PRSCRBR_ME = p.PRSCRBR_ME
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t ON p.TERR_ID = t.TERR_ID
WHERE r.PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110')
  AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-04-03' AND '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2
